features: VIPayment added as a server-side prepaid product provider with API credentials stored in Supabase Vault
VIPayment admin control supports credential setup, account/balance test, markup settings, production opt-in and catalog synchronization
Digital Market now reads from a multi-provider gateway that merges active H2H.id and VIPayment catalog summaries and products
VIPayment SKUs are internally namespaced to prevent collisions while keeping supplier routing invisible to customers
prepaid purchases are automatically routed to the provider that owns the selected SKU; postpaid remains on H2H.id
VIPayment supports DLavie sandbox simulation before production mode is enabled
existing official logos, feedback, Utility Orb, receipts and transaction confirmation safeguards remain active
note: v33 introduces VIPayment as an additional prepaid supplier without replacing H2H.id. Production VIPayment transactions remain opt-in and require valid credentials, catalog sync and sufficient provider balance.
